newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trading Tuesday on slaughter steers and heifers was very active, USDA said. Live sales were mostly $3.00 per cwt higher than last week; dressed basis sales mostly $2.00 higher than Monday.
Most buyers and sellers still willing, late in the day, to trade cattle at the current levels.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights ).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs - 68.00-69.00, couple loads to 69.50; dressed basis 111.00-112.00, late mostly 112.00, some early to 110.00. ( weighted average 111.61 ).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs - 68.00-69.00, few to 69.75, few early to 66.50; dressed basis 111.00-112.00, late mostly 112.00, some early to 110.00. ( weighted average 111.57 ).
Confirmed - 63,700 Last Week - 2,700 Last Year - 6,700 For week - 69,300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 6,200 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 13,700
